import mujoco, json
m = mujoco.MjModel.from_xml_path("mjcf.xml")
joints=[]
for i in range(m.njnt):
    name=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT,i)
    jt=int(m.jnt_type[i])
    typ={0:"free",1:"ball",2:"slide",3:"hinge"}[jt]
    ax=m.jnt_axis[i].tolist()
    lim=m.jnt_range[i].tolist() if m.jnt_limited[i] else None
    joints.append({"name":name,"type":typ,"axis":ax,"range":lim})
acts=[]
for i in range(m.nu):
    name=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_ACTUATOR,i)
    trn=m.actuator_trntype[i]
    tgt=m.actuator_trnid[i,0]
    if trn==0: jn=mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_JOINT,tgt)
    elif trn==3: jn="tendon:"+str(mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_TENDON,tgt))
    else: jn=None
    cr=m.actuator_ctrlrange[i].tolist() if m.actuator_ctrllimited[i] else None
    acts.append({"name":name,"joint":jn,"ctrlrange":cr})
sites=[mujoco.mj_id2name(m,mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_SITE,i) for i in range(m.nsite)]
print("NJNT",m.njnt,"NU",m.nu,"NV",m.nv)
print(json.dumps({"joints":joints,"acts":acts,"sites":sites},indent=1))
EOF

    cls=d.get("class")
    j=d.find("joint")

    if j is not None and j.get("range"): rng=[float(x) for x in j.get("range").split()]
    if cls: defaults[cls]=rng
    for sub in d.findall("default"):
        walk_default(sub)

        name=j.get("name")
        typ=j.get("type","hinge")
        axis=j.get("axis","1 0 0")
        cls=j.get("class")
        rng=j.get("range")

        joints.append({"name":name,"type":typ,"axis":[float(x) for x in axis.split()],"range":rng,"class":cls})

        walk(b)

    walk(b)
print(json.dumps(joints,indent=1))
